Its content is the procedure Phase C's goal asked for and got on the first try across all seven files, and that Phase A -- asked nothing -- did not do: agg-04 run1 shipped a count of 1 against 1,323 records without reconciling them. rlmh-prompt-crosscheck.title: Reconcile a count against its population before answering
rlmh-prompt-crosscheck.content: Before writing a final answer that is a count, or a single item located in a large file, verify it a second and independently written way, and reconcile the two results. Two habits, in order. First, whenever a pattern selects records out of a file, print how many records the file contains and how many your pattern matched, side by side; if those two numbers are not consistent with each other the pattern is wrong, not the file, and it must be fixed before answering. Second, compute the same quantity by a method that shares no code with the first -- a different regex, a line scan, a parse into records -- and compare. If the two disagree, do not pick one: find out why. A bucket that absorbs a large share of the population is the usual sign of a mis-specified pattern.
